title: doola MCP Is Now Live in Replit: Build the App and Form the Company in One Workspace
summary: doola MCP is live in Replit. Connect it once, ask Replit Agent to form your US LLC, and go from working app to filed company in one workspace.
body_markdown:
The app works. You built it in an afternoon with Replit Agent, and people are already asking to pay for it. But no company stands behind it yet. Every dollar that comes in lands in your personal account, and every user agreement is on you.


doola MCP first went live in two places in April 2026, and Replit was one of them. It’s now live across Claude, Replit, ChatGPT, Lovable, Perplexity, Vercel, Cursor and Grok Build.


With[doola MCP inside Replit](https://docs.doola.com/mcp/connect) , you form the company in the same workspace where you built the app.


“Replit is where people go from idea to working app in an afternoon. The company behind that app should take the same afternoon, not three weeks of forms and tabs. With doola MCP inside Replit Agent, the product and the company get built in the same place.”


Arjun Mahadevan, Founder & CEO, doola


You ship the app, and the company behind it ships with it.


## Going Global: Build a Borderless Business From Anywhere


Many Replit builders live outside the US. They ship to US customers from all over the world, and they all run into the same questions:


- Do I need a US address?


- Can I open a US bank account without an SSN?


- Which state is better for non-residents?


doola has answered these questions for 25,000+ founders across 175+ countries. You don’t need a US address or an SSN, and you never have to travel to the US.


After formation, eligible founders without an SSN can also get access to US business banking.


Not sure which state to choose? Ask Replit Agent during setup, and it will walk you through the options.


## Why Replit?


**Replit Is Where Ideas Become Working Software**


Replit Agent takes builders from a prompt to a running app, often without a traditional engineering background. That’s usually when a side project starts to look like a business.


**The Workflow Broke at Incorporation**


Builders could build, test, deploy, and share without leaving Replit. Then they needed a legal entity. At that point they had to leave Replit and start a separate process from scratch.


**The Gap doola MCP Fixes**


Now the Replit Agent that helped you build the app can also help you form the company behind it.


## What the Experience Looks Like


If you’ve formed an LLC the traditional way, you know how much back-and-forth it takes. Forming one through doola MCP in Replit is a much shorter process.


#### Phase 1: Before Payment


Replit Agent asks you a few questions:


- Where you live


- What you want to name your company


- Which state to file in (Wyoming by default)


- Which doola package fits your needs


Answer in plain language. If you’re unsure about something, such as which state to choose, ask and the agent will explain. Checkout then opens right in the session.


#### Phase 2: After Payment


The conversation continues from where you left off. Replit Agent collects the remaining details:


- Business description


- Backup company names


- Business and mailing address


- LLC members


- IRS responsible party


- Ownership split


doola files the LLC, provides your registered agent, and handles the backend processing. You’re then sent to your doola dashboard to get your EIN, set up banking, and complete your post-formation steps.


You stay in the same workspace the whole time, and you never have to copy, paste, or re-enter details you’ve already given.


## Step-by-Step: How to Connect doola MCP in Replit


You only need to connect doola once:


1. Open your Replit workspace.
2. Go to **Settings → Integrations → MCP Servers** for Replit Agent.
3. Search for doola.
4. Click Sign in.
5. Sign in to your doola account, or create a new one.
6. Complete the OAuth authorization flow.
7. Go back to Replit Agent and ask it to help you form an LLC with doola.

## FAQs


#### How does doola MCP work with Replit?


Find doola in the MCP Servers list under Replit’s integration settings, sign in with your doola account, and go back to Replit Agent. The agent then walks you through LLC formation in plain language.


doola handles the state filing, registered agent, and backend processing.


#### Can I actually form a real US LLC inside Replit?


Yes. doola files your LLC with the state, so it’s a real legal entity, not a draft or a placeholder. You can track your filing’s progress in real time on your doola dashboard.


#### Does it work if I’m not based in the US?


Yes. doola has helped founders from 175+ countries form US LLCs, including founders without a US SSN or a US mailing address. You never need to visit the US.


#### How long does LLC formation take through doola?


Wyoming and Delaware filings typically process in 1–3 business days.


After your LLC is approved, getting your EIN from the IRS takes another 1–5 business days.


#### What does doola handle after formation?


doola handles the full back office: registered agent, EIN, US business banking setup, bookkeeping, compliance and annual reports, and tax filing.


#### Is doola available in other AI tools?


Yes. doola MCP is live across Claude, Replit, ChatGPT, Lovable, Perplexity, Vercel, Cursor and Grok Build.
